prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: bespoke editorial illustration for the hero of Untangle, a caring digital-life-after-breakup web application.
Primary request: a young adult woman gently untangling a long lock of her hair with her fingers, feeling calm and quietly self-possessed.
Style: exquisite contemporary editorial paper-cut illustration with soft airbrushed texture, elegant sculptural shapes, rich nuanced shading; sophisticated art-book cover, not stock vector corporate art, not photographic. Graceful organic silhouettes.
Composition: square canvas 1024x1024, woman shown head to waist, in side three-quarter profile looking down to the left, positioned centrally with generous breathing room around her. Warm brown skin, deep aubergine flowing very long hair sweeping in sculptural arcs to the right, one beautifully drawn hand gently holding a separated thin peach strand to her left at chest height. Modest flowing light apricot shirt. Large warm apricot circular halo behind upper body, with delicate fine hair curves at its perimeter. Hair fills the lower right; portrait and halo occupy 85 percent of canvas.
Color palette: background is flat very dark plum #251B2B across entire image, including all edges; hair shades dark plum and mauve; skin rich warm terracotta, soft peach highlights; shirt butter apricot; halo warm dusty peach, subtle terracotta gradient. All corners remain dark plum so illustration blends into website.
Mood: tender, imaginative, luxurious, reassuring, alive. The woman is the protagonist in control, not distressed.
Constraints: one woman only. Correct hand anatomy. No text, no letters, no logo, no interface, no cards, no extra objects, no phones, no stars, no sparkles. Render only the illustration.
